title: AegisOps Experiment Manifest
description: Declarative, reproducible experiment configuration. Does NOT contain measured results.

schema_version.description: Exact schema version (locked to 1.0 for Phase 0)

experiment_id.description: Unique identity of the configured experiment

description.description: Optional extended context or purpose of the experiment

seed.description: Deterministic random seed required for reproducible execution

version.description: Specific version or tag of the dataset

reference.description: Logical or project-portable dataset location reference

scenario_id.description: Logical identity of the fault scenario

config_reference.description: Reference to the external scenario/fault CONFIGURATION used to reproduce the experiment

metrics.description: Requested metrics to collect/evaluate later (not measured results)

artifact_root.description: Logical or project-portable root/reference for experiment outputs

code_version.description: Code revision (e.g. Git SHA or semantic version) to use

conditions.description: Freeform JSON object for logging external fixed conditions (no secrets allowed)

metadata.description: Freeform JSON-safe research annotations (no secrets or measured values)
